title: Behind the Theatre Curtain
transcript: It's lovely to see some familiar faces in the audience for our backstage tour. We'll begin in the rehearsal room, where the cast usually has its first read through. You're welcome to leave anything bulky in the lockers outside that room, as the passages behind the stage are quite narrow. Once we're in the wings, look down and you'll see some strips of blue tape. Those show the crew where to put the larger pieces of scenery between scenes. Now, we've had to make a small change to the route. The wardrobe team is fitting costumes this afternoon, so we'll visit the sound booth in place of the costume store. To finish, you'll get a few minutes on the stage itself. You're welcome to take photos there, provided you keep the flash switched off.

questions.explanation: 参观从演员通常第一次集体读剧本的排练室开始。
体积较大的随身物品可以存放在房间外的储物柜里。
舞台侧面的蓝色胶带标明了大型布景在换场时的摆放位置。

questions.prompt: Where will the group go in place of the costume store?
questions.explanation: 服装组下午要试装，所以团队改去参观音控室。

questions.prompt: What rule applies to photos on stage?
options: Visitors must use a shared camera.
questions.explanation: 讲话者允许游客在舞台上拍照，条件是关闭闪光灯。
